text:
mei: quick heads-up from the q4k bring-up on canary: we're seeing reproducible detok jitter for mixed CJK+numeric lines when kvcache chunking and batching are enabled. chrF and BLEU drop on our locale suite.
tarun: can you paste a minimal repro and token ids? sounds like a tokenizer boundary shift.
mei: input: "上海市 2022 年度 报告（摘要）"
mei: baseline detok: 上海市 2022 年度 报告（摘要）
mei: q4k+kvcache detok: 上海市 2022 年度  报告（摘要）  <-- extra space before 报告
mei: baseline token ids: [1203, 4400, 90019, 77]
mei: q4k+kvcache ids:    [1203, 4400, 900, 19, 77]  // number split causes detok space

olga: interesting — does this happen with kvcache disabled or batch_size=1?
mei: no, single-example path matches baseline. Only reproduced when batch_size>1 and chunk_size>=64.
eval-bot: running targeted eval: 800 zh samples; BLEU delta = -2.9, numeric+paren subgroup delta = -5.8.
infra-bot: canary runtime note: kvcache chunking backend switched to fast-kv-v2 in build 2024-11-03.

tarun: two likely suspects: ordering of normalization vs batching in preproc, or a tokenizer merge rule interacting with our batched serializer. Can you run: (A) baseline weights + new runtime preproc (B) q4k weights + old preproc?
mei: launching both. quick local check shows the split happens when normalization is applied after batch-concat in the refactored path. Running per-example normalization removes the split.

olga: please add failing example to a unit test for tokenization-suite and gate the runtime refactor. Also file a rollback if canary doesn't stabilize.
mei: filing PR to revert normalization order on canary and adding tests. Will post eval links when jobs finish.
tarun: thanks — also search for similar JA/KO mixed-script cases; if it's systemic we block the q4k rollout.
eval-bot: rerun after revert: BLEU delta now -0.2, chrF delta -0.1. Numeric subgroup negligible.
mei: confirmed fix on canary. leaving notes in the onboarding checklist about kvcache+batching caveats.
